info.title: Amharic Adventist Hymnal API
info.description: Versioned, offline-first content API for hymn metadata, search, sheet music, and audio. Routes under /api remain available for the original Flutter contract; new integrations should use /api/v1.

get.description: Returns the service name, version and the URLs of the manifest and contract, in the standard v1 success envelope.
Served with `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`. Returned as a bare OpenAPI document, not wrapped in the success envelope.

get.summary: List every sheet-music page in the edition
get.description: One request that lets a client plan a complete offline install: every page with its size, checksum and download URL. The alternative is walking song detail for every hymn in the edition, which costs more requests than the download it precedes. `pagesSha256` folds in each page's checksum as well as its position, so a re-scanned page changes the hash and a client can detect it without diffing the list.

get.summary: Download one page of one song's sheet music
get.description: Per-page delivery. The edition's complete sheet-music bundle is a single large object that some object-store tiers refuse outright, so this is the supported way to obtain sheet music: each page is small, independently resumable, and verifiable against the checksum reported by song detail. Enumerate pages with `GET /songs/{songId}` and read `sheetMusic.pages[].pageNumber`.

bearerAuth.description: Supabase access token. Only the /api/v1/admin surface requires it; every content route is anonymous.

Range.name: Range
Range.description: RFC 9110 byte range, for example bytes=0-1048575

NotFound.description: Language, version, song, or media was not found

InternalError.description: Unexpected server failure with no stack trace

source.description: recording: a performance. synthesized: the tune rendered from MIDI with a General MIDI soundfont, which sounds like an organ rather than singers. Label synthesized tracks so a listener does not mistake them for a poor recording.

attribution.description: A sentence to show as-is describing where the audio came from. Set on synthesized tracks; null on recordings with no credit recorded.

contentUpdatedAt.description: When anything a client stores for this edition last changed: a song, category, audio track or sheet-music page. Compare with the stored value; run /sync only when it moved.

sheetMusicAvailable.description: The complete sheet-music archive exists. Frequently false even when the edition has full sheet music, because pages are published individually.

sheetMusicPageCount.description: Sheet-music pages published for this edition, counted per file, independent of the archive.

capabilities.description: What a client may offer for this edition, derived from what actually exists. Render features from these flags rather than hardcoding which edition has what: editions genuinely differ, and a newly created one has none of it until content is published.

audio.description: Any audio at all, in any form.

individualAudioDownload.description: A single hymn's audio can be downloaded on its own. Deliberately separate from audioBundle: per-song audio and the complete-audio archive come from different publishing steps, so an edition routinely has the first without the second.

audioBundle.description: A prebuilt complete-audio archive exists for this edition.

sheetMusic.description: Sheet music is obtainable in some form. True when the edition has pages even if no archive exists.

sheetMusicPages.description: Individual pages can be downloaded via /songs/{songId}/sheet-music/pages/{pageNumber}/file. Prefer this over the archive: it is the primary delivery path, and the archive is often absent because it is a single object too large for some object-store tiers.

sheetMusicBundle.description: A prebuilt complete sheet-music archive exists. Often false; do not treat it as a proxy for whether sheet music exists.

songs.description: The edition has any published content at all.

rights.description: Rights in the HYMN (its text and tune), for attribution. Null when the song has no canonical work yet.

similarEditions.description: Hymns marked similar -- another translation, other verses or a different tune. Show as "similar to"; nothing is shared. Song detail only; empty on lists.

Release.description: A published content release. `status` is independent of `isCurrent`: status answers whether a release is publishable at all, isCurrent answers which release clients are served. Rollback moves isCurrent to an older PUBLISHED release and marks the bad one DEPRECATED without deleting its binaries.

version.description: Operator-facing label such as 2026.1. NOT orderable - never sort releases by parsing this.

releaseNumber.description: Monotonic per edition. This is the orderable value.

minimumAppVersion.description: Oldest client build that can correctly consume this release. Null means no floor. Check this BEFORE acting on the manifest.

manifestHash.description: SHA-256 over a canonical description of everything the release publishes. One comparison answers whether anything changed since the release the client holds.

MediaBundle.description: A pre-built archive belonging to one release. Emitted alongside sheetMusic and audio.allPackage, not instead of them; this is the representation clients should migrate to.

objectEtag.description: The object store's own ETag, recorded at upload. Distinct from checksumSha256, which is what the client verifies after download.

assetCount.description: Number of files inside the archive.

SheetMusicPageList.description: Every sheet-music page in one edition, in hymn then page order.

totalSizeBytes.description: Combined size of every page, so a client can show the cost of a full install before starting it.

pagesSha256.description: Digest over each page's song, position and checksum. Store it and compare on the next sync to decide whether anything needs re-downloading.

SheetMusicPageListEntry.description: One page in the edition-wide listing. A sheet printing two hymns appears once per hymn, with a different pageNumber in each.

isShared.description: The same file also prints another hymn. Store it once; it appears in this list under each hymn it serves.

borrowedFromVersionCode.description: Edition code these scans came from, or null when they are this edition's own. Non-null means the hymn number PRINTED on the page belongs to that edition, not the one requested: 1975 #130 shows a sheet printed 132, because 1975 was never scanned and borrows 2004's. Show the source rather than leaving the reader to wonder.

SheetMusicPage.description: One page of a hymn's sheet music, downloadable on its own. Per-page delivery is the primary path: the edition's complete archive is a single object large enough that some object-store tiers refuse it outright, so an edition commonly publishes pages and no archive. Verify each page against checksumSha256 after download.

pageNumber.description: Position within THIS hymn, always 1..N with no gaps regardless of the source filename.

pageSide.description: Which half of a two-page spread this image is.

fileName.description: Path of this page inside the sheet-music archive.

downloadUrl.description: Absolute URL for this page, already carrying the edition selector. Use it as given rather than assembling one: an unqualified URL resolves against the default edition, and because editions share canonical works it can return a legible page of the wrong book instead of an error.

isShared.description: True when the same physical sheet also prints another hymn. Cache by fileName, not by hymn, or the file is stored twice.

borrowedFromVersionCode.description: Edition code these scans came from, or null when they are this edition's own. Non-null means the hymn number PRINTED on the page belongs to that edition, not the one requested: 1975 #130 shows a sheet printed 132, because 1975 was never scanned and borrows 2004's. Show the source rather than leaving the reader to wonder.

SongSheetMusic.description: Per-hymn sheet-music availability. pages is present only on song detail; a list response carries availability and count alone.

SongEdition.description: The same canonical hymn as printed by a different edition - the old-to-new hymn number map. Populated on song detail only; list responses carry an empty array rather than omitting the key.

AdminReport.description: A report as an operator sees it. Distinct from the receipt the sender gets, which carries only an id, a reference and a status.

reference.description: Six characters shown to the sender, e.g. A1B2C3. Search matches it.

context.description: What the app sent about itself: appVersion, platform, osVersion, deviceModel, screen, locale.

otherEditions.description: The same hymn in other editions. Filled on the single-report route only.

songCount.description: Active songs currently referencing this category. Non-zero on a retired category means songs still point at it.

action.description: Dotted verb, e.g. category.created, category.retired, report.status_changed.

isActive.description: False means the category was retired. Remove it from the browse UI but keep any songs that referenced it.

Rights.description: Rights in a hymn. UNKNOWN means nobody has recorded an answer — it is NOT a statement that the hymn is free to use, and must not be rendered as one.

contentVersion.description: Retained for compatibility and NOT reliable release identity - it falls back to a bundle version string, and finally to the literal unreleased. Prefer release.version.

release.description: Null means this edition has never published, which is a normal state, not an error.

bundles.description: Current bundles in the generalised representation. Empty for editions published before media_bundles existed, which is why sheetMusic and audio.allPackage above are still populated.

categories.description: Categories created, renamed or retired since `since`. Retired ones have isActive false.

sheetMusicPages.description: Sheet-music pages added, replaced or withdrawn since `since`, once per hymn a page belongs to. Re-read /songs/{songId} for each songId named.

songId.description: The hymn the report is about, if any. Must exist in the edition sent as `version`.

contact.description: Email or phone, ONLY if the user chose to leave one so they can be answered.

context.description: Filled in by the app, not typed by the user. Every field optional.

screen.description: Where in the app the report was sent from.

reference.description: Show this to the user, e.g. Report A1B2C3 received.
